verdict.rationale: Jira's own integrations page documents syncing Trello with Jira, which brings work from one other project management tool into Jira. Combined with its board, list, timeline and calendar views, that partially approximates a unified view. Marketplace apps and Rovo's connections to third-party data are add-ons or adjacent features and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented aggregation of assigned tasks across multiple non-Atlassian PM tools (e.g., Asana, Linear), a dedicated unified 'my work' view spanning tools, details of how the Trello sync behaves, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view

citations.quote: Collaborate across tools with transparency and create workflows that work for you by syncing Trello and Jira Software.
Stay up-to-date on the work's progress using the view you like: boards, lists, timeline, or calendars.
